title: OpenAI models face a new test in theoretical science
teaser: OpenAI’s math results are beginning to look less like a story about one field and more like a test of how far AI can reach into theoretical science. A new study by Thompson and colleagues evaluated six OpenAI models on research problems published after those models’ training cutoffs. The problems were drawn from areas where researchers could assess reasoning without simulations or experiments, making the results a limited but useful check on whether models can do more than reproduce familiar answers.
